evals.prompt: 通过当前 harness 已配置好的 AIFlow 生成一张 1024x1024 PNG 产品概念图，保存到项目的 outputs/product.png。
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the unified AIFlow CLI, discovers a live image-capable canonical model, writes the verified bitmap and provenance sidecar, and reports safe artifact metadata.
expectations: Uses scripts/aiflow_image.py rather than requiring aiflow-basic or a provider API.
Uses live supports_image_generation capability and does not guess a newest model.
Produces one image plus a provenance sidecar without printing Base64 or credentials.

evals.prompt: 为智域基石公众号做 3 套机器人触觉主题首图，输出横版和方图，保持主体一致，最后放官方 Logo 和标题。
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a bounded candidate round through separate AIFlow requests, separates generated pixels from official Logo/text composition, records every artifact, and runs VI release QA.
expectations: Does not ask the model to generate the official Logo or final text.
Uses separate n=1 requests with unique output paths for the candidate set.
Creates deterministic crop variants and records provenance.
Loads archebase-vi-guide and runs brand release gates.

evals.prompt: 用 AIFlow 做一组保持同一机器人角色和工业场景风格的四张活动海报底图，并说明每轮修改依据。
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a consistency dossier, states reference/edit limitations, uses controlled prompt iterations and records selected outputs and hypotheses.
expectations: Defines subject and style invariants before generation.
Changes named variables rather than making vague repeat requests.
Does not claim reference-image consistency without an implemented adapter.

evals.prompt: Generate a campaign master through AIFlow and save the exact image into this project. If the UI does not display the result, do not generate it again.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the saved bitmap and provenance sidecar as the source of truth and never regenerates merely because UI delivery failed.
expectations: Uses the live-selected AIFlow canonical image model without silently switching providers.
Does not regenerate when a completed artifact exists but UI delivery failed.
Returns the exact verified workspace bitmap and provenance path.

evals.prompt: 当前 AIFlow 给我显示了两个都支持图像生成的模型，但我没有指定用哪个。请直接选最新的那个生成。
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses to infer recency from model names and asks for an explicit model or AIFLOW_IMAGE_MODEL preference, returning safe canonical IDs.
expectations: Does not rank or select models by lexical version name.
Returns model_selection_required or requests an explicit preference.
Does not expose provider accounts or physical routes.

evals.prompt: Add support for a future non-GPT text-to-image model without claiming features that have not been tested.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps the adapter unsupported until executable positive evidence and fail-closed negative controls cover its capability contract.
expectations: Does not infer compatibility from an OpenAI-like API shape.
Records discovery, limits, output transport, provenance and retry/billing behavior.
Keeps the adapter unsupported until verified evidence exists.
